thesis: Layered evidence, scoped permissions, contestable remedies and diverse funding address specific problems without monopolizing meaning.
role: Offer an operational and institutional response with explicit limitations.

ideas.statement: Versioned component ledgers, activity-specific AI contracts and accountable review triggers replace unscoped clearance banners.
Hashes, timestamps, signatures, provenance, reservations and watermarks have bounded technical roles and cannot prove ownership or authorize uses.
Licensing and compensation require governance: output similarity, causal contribution, legal entitlement and social reward are different allocation questions.
Enforcement should explain specific protected correspondences, permit challenge and choose proportionate remedies instead of automated semantic censorship.
Reject a monopoly over semantic equivalence while enforcing actual rights; public funding, scoped licensing and small-actor access need outcome evaluation.
An illustrative ninety-day program inventories assets, builds release gates, rehearses disputes and reassesses value under lawful competition.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Management categories, policy proposals and contribution-based compensation are not legal safe harbours or enacted royalties; retention itself has privacy and confidentiality costs.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
